newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Mycogen, DeKalb raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Mycogen, DeKalb raised to buy.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth analyst Bonnie Wittenburg said Monday she raised seed and agricultural biotech companies DeKalb Genetics Inc and Mycogen Corp to a buy from a hold.
-- She reiterated a buy on Pioneer Hi-Bred Internationl Inc.
-- In a report, Wittenburg cited the expected sale, likely by year-end, of Holden Foundation Seeds, a seed company.

-- "Holden sale is expected to touch off another consolidation round in the seed industry, with the losers in the Holden battle looking harder than before for other ways to find (seed) germplasm," Wittenburg wrote in a report.

-- Wittenburg said she believes Pioneer has strong fundamentals for the next couple of years, noting that its ability to ramp up new products will enable the higher margin biotech products to start making a significant contribution to the product mix in 1998. She said she considers Pioneer is the least likely to be taken over, but did not rule out hostile takeover attempts. Pioneer shares were down 1-3/8 at 68-3/8.
-- She said DeKalb, which is partially held by Monsanto Co, has strong fundamentals in the short-term and a "good" biotech position. DeKalb shares were up 1/8 at 37-3/8.
-- Wittenburg also reiterated a buy on Monsanto. Its shares were down 7/8 at 39-1/8.

-- The analyst said Mycogen appears to have an especially strong position with Bt technology to make plants resistant to certain insects, adding this technology likely will be the most important over the next five years.
-- "Mycogen needs more depth and breadth to its breeding material base, but it has several strong Bt patents," Wittenburg said.
